title: OTLP exporter regression harness with backend mock suite and golden-trace validator
creator: Asha Patel
description:
Problem: We frequently see regressions in OTLP exporter behavior (encoding, headers, compression, retry semantics) that only surface after vendor onboarding or production traffic spikes. Root causes range from subtle wire-format mismatches to backpressure handling differences across Jaeger/Tempo/backing storage. Existing unit tests are insufficient to catch these.

Goal: Build a self-contained regression test harness that can: (1) spin up lightweight mock backends (Jaeger-like, Tempo-like, S3 archival shim), (2) drive exporter implementations with synthetic traffic patterns (burst, steady-state, high-cardinality, long-running spans), (3) simulate network conditions (latency, packet loss, partial failures), (4) validate ingested traces against a set of golden-trace expectations and schema contracts, and (5) integrate into CI to block PRs that introduce behavioral changes.

Acceptance criteria: 
- A reusable CLI and test runner (go/python/ts) that can be invoked locally and from CI.
- Mock backends supporting OTLP/gRPC and OTLP/HTTP, with configurable responses (ok, transient error 5xx, retry-after, slow).
- A library of 15+ golden trace scenarios (including kafka batch producers, async worker spans, synthetic high-cardinality attributes, span links) with deterministic validation logic.
- Network fault injection knobs (latency, jitter, packet loss) that run inside local harness and in CI.
- Test results provide deterministic diff output and a human-readable summary; failures must link to a failure artifact (mock backend logs, pcap-like trace of requests, golden vs actual JSON).
- CI gating enabled on the repo for all exporter and collector changes.

Design notes: 
- Harness will be implemented in Go (align with many Redwood infra services) with a thin Python shim for local developer ergonomics.
- Use lightweight in-process mock servers for speed and determinism; persist archives of request envelopes to disk for post-mortem.
- Golden traces stored as newline-delimited JSON with a small harness API for matching (field-level ignore/allow lists, regex matchers for stable ids).
- Include an optional mode that runs real vendor binaries (Tempo, Jaeger) inside ephemeral containers to run full-stack comparisons when needed.
- Scoring: tests emit a pass/fail and a difference score (0-100) for non-binary regressions; threshold configurable per test.

Implementation plan: 
1) Prototype mock backend and one golden trace (kafka-batch to span conversion) — 1 week.
2) Expand to 6 golden scenarios + network knobs — 1.5 weeks.
3) Integrate harness with CI, add artifact uploads and deterministic diff output — 1 week.
4) Add containerized vendor-run mode and developer CLI ergonomics — 1 week.

Risks & mitigations: 
- Risk: flakiness from network simulation -> Mitigate by using deterministic pseudo-random seeds and stable time progression in harness.
- Risk: scope creep (many vendor-specific behaviors) -> Start with common contract checks and allow per-vendor extension plugins.

Metrics & dashboards: 
- Add a small dashboard for CI history (regressions by PR, flakiness rate).
- Hook harness results to the Console test-run dashboard for easier triage.

Rollout & rollout plan: 
- Initial opt-in: enable gating for the exporter repo for non-critical branches.
- Phase 2: block mainline merges for contributors who touch exporter/collector code.

Notes on compatibility with existing infra: Leverage the existing trace ingest mocks and the test artifact S3 bucket (observability-test-artifacts). Ensure the harness adheres to existing log and artifact naming conventions.
comments: 2026-02-25 - Asha Patel: Created ticket after repeat flaky exporter regressions on staging. Linked a recent incident: CON-2026-03-exporter-timeout (Confluence).
2026-02-27 - Diego Morales: Spike started. Prototype mock server scaffolded in go under github.com/redwood/trace-harness (WIP).

2026-03-03 - Design review: PM asked to ensure test artifacts integrate with the Console 'test-runs' panel. Agreed to add test-run metadata headers. Action: Diego to add metadata to artifact payloads.

2026-03-06 - Engineering: Initial 6 golden traces implemented: kafka-batch, http-client, db-span, async-worker, span-links, archived-spans. Running locally shows deterministic matches. PR: github.com/redwood/trace-harness/pull/12

2026-03-08 - QA: Began running harness in CI. Observed 2 failures caused by exporter retries changing backoff timing. Decided to add configurable timing normalization to golden validator to avoid brittle timings.

2026-03-10 - Blocker discovered: some collector builds use a non-idempotent header serialization. Created ENG-934101 to track collector header normalization. Until that is resolved, CI gating will be advisory (report-only).
